---
title: "Manuscript: MPX NYC Intervention Strategy"
---



```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
#| label: fig-radarsexorientation
#| fig-cap: "Sexual Orientation of MPX NYC Participants"
#| 


sexorient_labels <- c(
                      "gay" = "Gay", 
                      "bisexual" = "Bisexual", 
                      "queer" = "Queer",
                      "straight" = "Straight",
                       "something-else" = "Another\nOrientation"
                      )

  mpxnyc_1_person_data %>%
    mutate(sexOrientation = factor(sexOrientation, names(sexorient_labels), sexorient_labels )) %>%
    group_by(sexOrientation) %>%
    summarize(count = n()) %>%
    filter(!is.na(sexOrientation)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(level = sexOrientation) %>%
    mutate(proportion = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot() + 
        ggplot2::geom_bar(aes(x = level, fill = level, y = proportion), width = 1, stat = "identity") + 
        ggplot2::theme_void() + 
        ggplot2::theme(
                        legend.position = "none", 
                        panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(size = 0.1),
                        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45),
                        axis.text.y = element_text()
                        ) + 
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(
                                              mpxnyc_colors$dark_blue, 
                                              mpxnyc_colors$dark_pink, 
                                              mpxnyc_colors$dark_purple, 
                                              mpxnyc_colors$light_blue, 
                                              mpxnyc_colors$light_pink, 
                                              mpxnyc_colors$light_purple,
                                              mpxnyc_colors$light_green)
          ) + 
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + 
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(2,2,2,2, "cm")
    )
  

```
